mapper.select: SELECT /* getImageLikeTarget */ U.USER_NUMB AS TARGET_USER_NUMB , #{commYes} AS LIKE_ALIM_YSNO FROM TM_USERXM U JOIN TM_USERXM ACTOR ON ACTOR.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND ACTOR.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} WHERE U.USER_STAT = #{userStatActive} AND ( (#{tagtType} = #{targetProfile} AND U.PROF_NUMB = #{tagtNumb}) OR (#{tagtType} = #{targetBackground} AND U.BGIM_NUMB = #{tagtNumb}) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM TB_USBLOC B WHERE (B.USER_NUMB = #{userNumb} AND B.BLOC_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB) OR (B.USER_NUMB = U.USER_NUMB AND B.BLOC_NUMB = #{userNumb}) )
